about.title: About
paragraphs: I'm a Quality Assurance professional with a keen eye for detail and a soft spot for how multidisciplinary the field is. Over five years I've done manual and automated testing across web, mobile and API, for banking, retail and enterprise platforms, and most recently on games, as QA for Hell Clock at Rogue Snail.

That work sits alongside my interests in UX/UI, information security and games. The mix helps me spot usability friction and technical details that others might overlook, and keep deliveries focused on the people who will actually use them.

highlights: Mapped, triaged and documented 200+ bugs and crash reports in Jira, managing their lifecycle and owning the PC build's quality
Took over PC validation so the team could split its effort across consoles and mobile, widening multiplatform coverage
Analyzed complex mechanics, skill synergies, itemization and theorycrafting, drawing on 4,000+ hours of Action RPGs
Proposed design and balance changes to skills and items that the team adopted, improving the player experience
Supported players directly: technical help, answering questions and investigating community-reported bugs
Ran tests with the community's beta testers through public betas and PTRs
Planned and ran end-to-end testing for web and mobile apps across Salesforce and banking-correspondent (Corban) integrations
Kept deliveries compliant with strict business requirements
Built and maintained automated suites with Selenium, Playwright and Java, raising efficiency and coverage
Owned the full lifecycle of automated workflow testing in IBM BAW
Built the suites with Java, Selenium, Cucumber and a custom framework
Took part in agile ceremonies, pipeline management and documentation
Worked with the global team in English to resolve issues
Led quality initiatives across four agile and traditional squads
Took part in strategic decisions, with a user-oriented testing focus
Coordinated onboarding and training for new team members
Led web and API test automation with Robot Framework in Python
Reported quality to management on a regular basis
Wrote and ran comprehensive test plans, and produced detailed quality reports
Drove the software quality culture on the project
Contributed to UX/UI design and the first product designs
Turned client needs into product requirements with the architecture team

items.author: Sergio Oliveira
items.text:
Vladmir has clarity of vision and his opinions are always very assertive.
His involvement in projects helps uncover unforeseen, undiscussed situations early, avoiding financial and schedule risks. He also strongly supports the developers in achieving quality code and better development practices.
Without a doubt, he is a distinctive professional, above the market average.
items.highlight: helps uncover unforeseen, undiscussed situations early, avoiding financial and schedule risks

items.author: Felipe Todeschini
items.role: Lead Game Designer & Team Leader · Rogue Snail
items.text:
We first met Vladimir as one of the most active and knowledgeable players in the Hell Clock community. Before joining the team, he was already creating build videos, helping players on Reddit and Discord, and maintaining a wiki for the game. His understanding of our game systems, builds, progression, and endgame was what initially caught our attention.

After joining us as QA, that knowledge translated very well into the actual development process. Vladimir is especially good at testing complex interactions between Skills, Gear, progression systems, and different builds — which is extremely important in an ARPG where a small change can create unexpected problems somewhere else.

He also showed us a good understanding of the difference between a bug, a balance issue, and a design problem. Because he came from the community, he was also very competent at bringing relevant player feedback to the team and giving us context on why certain issues mattered.

Vladimir worked with us on our two main content expansions, Journey of Nightmares and Journey of Miracles, where he helped us validate large amounts of new content, balance changes and new gameplay mechanics across both updates.

He would be a great addition to any team working on ARPGs, RPGs, or other system-heavy games that require someone with a strong understanding of complex mechanics and who can somehow find those crazy bugs and unexpected interactions that slipped past the rest of the team.
items.highlight: can somehow find those crazy bugs and unexpected interactions that slipped past the rest of the team

items.author: Ramon Amorim
items.text: Vlad is one of the most talented people I have ever had the opportunity to work with. From the very start, he showed a genuine passion for our project and an involvement that went far beyond the responsibilities of his role. One of the things I admire most about him is his proactivity. He didn't stop at identifying problems: he made a point of thinking critically about them and, more often than not, already came with possible solutions. He is someone who truly cares about the quality of the work he delivers and about the success of the project as a whole. On top of all that, Vlad adapted to our team very quickly. He always communicated excellently, expressing his ideas clearly and contributing a great deal to the teamwork. I would work with him again without a second thought, and I strongly recommend his work to anyone who has the chance to count on him.
items.highlight: more often than not, already came with possible solutions

items.author: Rodrigo Lobo
items.text: I had the opportunity to meet and work with Vladmir as a QA Analyst, and it was an extremely positive experience. A great partner and communicator, he showed great attention to detail, always seeking the best coverage and reliability in tests and identifying scenarios that are often overlooked. We worked together with Java, Cucumber, Playwright and Allure, where he showed technical mastery and proactivity in test automation. Always committed, he contributed valuable suggestions for process improvements and best practices. On top of that, his constant drive to learn and share knowledge raises the performance of the whole team.
items.highlight: identifying scenarios that are often overlooked

items.author: Erika Ferrari Viviani Schneider
items.text: I had the honour of working alongside Vladmir on a highly complex, disruptively innovative project that will help change the energy matrix and the way this asset, fundamental to society, is traded. Always calm and balanced, Vladmir brought reason to heated discussions and quality by design to the product. To whoever reads this: having Vladmir on the team means getting human and technical skills in one person. I recommend him with my eyes closed.
items.highlight: brought reason to heated discussions and quality by design to the product

items.author: Lucas Duarte
items.text: I had the privilege of working with Vladmir and can safely say he is one of the most committed and competent Quality Assurance professionals I have ever met. Vladmir has a sharp analytical eye, attention to detail and an impressive ability to anticipate possible failures. His approach to manual and automated testing added immense value to the quality of our work. One of his standout traits is his collaborative spirit and communication, always willing to help, discuss and suggest improvements.
items.highlight: an impressive ability to anticipate possible failures

items.author: Haribaskar R
items.text: I highly recommend Vladimir. He's a resourceful problem-solver with a keen ability to automate tasks using Selenium and Java. His passion lies in finding efficient solutions, and he consistently demonstrates a knack for breaking down challenges and developing effective approaches. Vladimir would be a valuable asset to any team seeking an automation expert with a results-oriented mindset.
